ssurgo.provider: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
ssurgo.evidence_role: mapped permanent soil properties and available-water storage capacity

fortyguard_heat.interpretation_warning: Peak-hour values remain raw because the FortyGuard response timezone is unverified; do not label them as local time until the provider confirms the basis.

nasa_power_climate.interpretation_warning: NASA POWER is modeled gridded climate evidence, not an on-farm sensor measurement.

interpretation_warnings: Modeled weather-grid evidence; not an on-farm sensor measurement.
Modeled soil moisture and temperature; permanent soil properties come from SSURGO or a soil test.
Rain minus ET0 is a screening indicator, not an irrigation prescription.

ssurgo_soil.soil_root_limit_basis: SSURGO reported no restriction; gSSURGO 150 cm fallback
interpretation_warnings: SSURGO is mapped survey evidence, not a field or laboratory measurement.
Available-water capacity is storage context, not current soil moisture, rainfall, irrigation, or seasonal supply.
Valid farmer measurements or laboratory soil tests override mapped values while preserving both sources.
